Exam Date & Time: 20-Aug-2022 (10:00 AM - 01:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS (MIT MANIPAL) - AUGUST 2022  
  SUBJECT : CHM 1051 - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  (MAKEUP)  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1051]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Describe the electrode reactions during the discharging cycle and the constructional  
  aspects of Nickel - cadmium cell. Mention any two of its characteristics.                (4)  
  
1B)          Give reasons for the following:  
  i) Salt bridge is used in the construction of an electrochemical cell.                     (2)  
  ii) Glass electrode requires frequent standardization.  
  
1C)          Write the cell representation and calculate the thermodynamic parameters ∆G, ∆H and  
  ∆S for the reaction Zn + FeSO4 → ZnSO4 + Fe at 298 K. The temperature coefficient is  
  (4)  
  - 0.25 mVdeg-1. The reduction potentials E0 of Zn and Fe are - 0.76 V and - 0.44 V  
  respectively.  
  
2A)          Describe the experimental setup and procedure for determining decomposition potential  
  of an electrolyte.                                                                    (4)  
  
2B)          About 5.0 g coal sample was weighed into a silica crucible and heated for one hour at  
  110 0C. The residue weighed 4.875 g. The crucible was covered with a lid and strongly  
  heated for seven minutes at 950 0C. The residue weighed 3.452 g. The crucible was then (2)  
  heated without the cover until a constant weight was obtained. The last residue weighed  
  0.425 g. Calculate % moisture, volatile matter, ash & fixed carbon.  
  
2C)          Explain the analytical method for the determination of carbon and hydrogen in a coal  
  sample.                                                                                    (4)  
  
3A)          Give the principle involved and describe the sacrificial anode cathodic protection  
  method with a suitable example.                                                            (4)  
  
3B)          Justify the following statements:  
  i) Steel pipe in a large copper tank corrodes causing rapid destruction.                   (2)  
  ii) Galvanised articles cannot be used for storing foodstuffs.  
  
3C)          Distinguish between the following: (ANY TWO points)  
  i) Dry and wet corrosion.  
  ii) Galvanic and electrochemical series.                                                   (4)  
  iii) Anodic and cathodic corrosion inhibitors.  
  iv) Galvanization and tinning.  
  
4A)          What are liquid crystals? Write note on the various phases exhibited by liquid crystals.  
  (4)  
  
4B)          Name any two types of volumetric titrations with a suitable example for each.              (2)

4C)             i) An absorbance of 0.02 was recorded, with a metal-ligand complex having the  
  concentration 4 mM and the path length of 1.7 cm. Calculate molar extinction  
  coefficient (in dm3 mol-1 cm-1) for the complex. Calculate the concentration of the   (4)  
  complex, if the absorbance is 0.5  
  ii) Mention any four limitations of Beer-Lambert's Law.  
  
5A)             Differentiate between: (Any 4 points)  
  i) Ionic and covalent compounds.                                                      (4)  
  ii) PVD and CVD techniques.  
  
5B)             What is fiber reinforced composite? What are their characteristics?  
  (2)  
  
5C)             i) A polymer sample which has 20% molecules with a molecular mass of 20000 units,  
  50% molecules having a molecular mass of 30000, while the remaining 30% have a  
  molecular mass of 40000 units. Calculate the number-average and weight- average       (4)  
  molecular mass of polymer.  
  ii) What is glass transition temperature?Mention the factors that influence it.  
  
  
-----End-----
